articles.summary: With a population of 1.47 billion, India has the potential to be the largest poultry market in the world. No wonder India’s poultry industry is rapidly transforming. As urban lifestyles change and consumer expectations rise, the demand for safe, high-quality, and convenient poultry products is growing fast. In this evolving market, JBT Marel can be a key partner for processors who are looking to modernize and scale their operations.
articles.title: JBT Marel supports the modernization of India’s poultry industry

articles.summary: Downtime in a poultry processing plant is extremely costly, both financially and reputationally. Even a single underperforming machine can disrupt the entire process. At JBT Marel, preventing downtime is our priority. Because we know that a defective part can bring your operations to a standstill, our priority is to get you back up and running as quickly as possible. Through a combination of preventive maintenance and timely spare parts, we are partnering with you to help you maintain lifetime performance across your operation.
articles.title: Preventing downtime with maintenance and spares

articles.summary: Most food processors running an ERP believe they have solid financial visibility with procurement, accounts payable, invoicing, and inventory all accessible. Which is why the instinctive response from finance leadership to the suggestion to add a Manufacturing Execution System (MES), is predictable: we already have a system. The response is understandable, but ERP alone, or ERP and MES systems that don’t work together, can result in significantly reduced ROI.
articles.title: C-Suite insights: Unlocking ROI with MES and ERP in food manufacturing

articles.summary: The Fresh’n Squeeze® 3300 is incorporating the same industrial whole fruit extraction technology the brand is known for – which produces 50% more juice per fruit than traditional cut-and-press methods.
articles.title: JBT Marel launches new Fresh’n Squeeze® 3300 Citrus Juicer
